name: CRESTLINE
concept: An original long, low 1960s hardtop silhouette (no specific make or model) rebuilt in 2099 around an electromagnetic hover conversion. It keeps the lowrider language: candy paint, chrome, tiny wire wheels, pinstripe and a body that dances on its suspension.
units: metres; +X forward, +Z up, origin at the centre of the footprint on the ground

wheels.note: tiny chrome wire wheels; they spin but carry no weight

hover.emission: hoverViolet core with warmGold inner ring
hover.struts: chrome A-arms from body to each pod; visible, articulated

suspension.note: per-corner offsets driven by visual/sync/<cand>.cues.json; kicks bounce, the slam drops all four corners, the hop lifts the nose

lights.head: two thin horizontal light bars, warm white
lights.grille: horizontal chrome bars over a dim violet glow

materials.body: candyBurgundy with candyBurgundyFlash flake under a clear coat
